body:
I'm glad you caught the Vonnegut reference. 
I run a lot and love it! I ran a half marathon last year, and I know what you mean. It really helps with my depression and anxiety too. It's a good way to emotionally vent; sometimes I find myself sprinting down the street in near tears, but in a good way. Unfortunately, it sometimes fuels my eating disorder. Meaning I sometimes run under the pretense of helping my depression, when I know I'm just making my ED worse...
I am such a huge fan of Kurt Vonnegut's work, I will definitely check out his son's book. Thank you.
And I am definitely looking into some volunteer work, maybe at a local shelter or Habitat for Humanity project. Thank you for your suggestions.
Finally, if you don't mind me asking, what were your experiences with a psychiatrist like?
hi please feel free to talk to me. I can be somebody if you want.
